tool_args.rationale: The archived siphon with a positive square-root branch matches all five pilot rows to rounding precision. Above a fitted gradient threshold near 2.544, the deficit divided by drive grows linearly with gradient at slope about 1.694. The resulting law matches all eight paid rows to rounding precision and is ready for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Two-layer siphon with no threshold loss
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It matches the pilot rows to rounding precision but systematically overpredicts all three high-gradient rows.
The high-gradient deficits are not linear in gradient alone; dividing by drive makes them linear to rounding precision.
The eight paid rows already identify the threshold law at the target horizon; trajectory data are not needed before confirmation.
